**Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.**
A clear and concise description of what the problem is.

**Describe the solution you'd like**
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen — what
the URL grammar / CLI / on-bucket layout would look like, and why
this carves cleanly out of the existing surface.

**Describe alternatives you've considered**
Other approaches you weighed and why this one wins.

**Backend scope**
Which backend(s) does this affect? S3 / Azure / both / a new one?

**Additional context**
Any other context, link to relevant cloud-provider docs, related
issues.
